title: Worst-case $L_p$-approximation of periodic functions using median lattice algorithms
summary: We study the worst-case approximation of multivariate periodic functions from the weighted Korobov space $H_{d,α,γ}$ with smoothness $α>1/2$ in the Lebesgue norm $L_p([0,1]^d)$ for $1\le p\le\infty$. We analyze a \emph{median lattice algorithm} that reconstructs a truncated Fourier series by approximating the coefficients on a hyperbolic-cross-type index set using $R$ rank-1 lattice sampling rules with independent randomly chosen generating vectors, and then aggregating the resulting coefficient estimators via the componentwise median.
